'''Q-Z5''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and stationed near canyons on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Information Appropriation" />

==Description==
The droid's primary programming was to track the enemy data flow and provide the Imperial strike teams with personnel recordings. This task was fulfilled during an assault on the enemy's communications control bunker, rewarding the Imperials with intel on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonist's]] troop movements.<ref name="Information Appropriation" />
